title: FiberSteel mode: an optional staff demo

scenes.narration: FiberSteel mode is an optional staff side of the same system, one click from the website. It's purely a demo, to show what's possible. A real one would be customized to how FiberSteel works.
Staff pick a profile, and each one shows what that role works with.
The dashboard is today at a glance: the schedule, from installs on the water to the shop's builds, new requests, and what needs attention.
Every request lands in one inbox: website forms, phone calls, walk-ins, Facebook and boat shows.
A quote request shows the boat and the slip, with FiberSteel's formula worked out, ready to book a site visit or write the quote.
Site visits, shop builds, installs and service calls move across a board, from needs scheduling to done.
And the schedule shows the week for each crew and the shop.
Each customer has their lifts, with serial numbers, and the warranty worked out part by part.
Warranty claims and registrations have their own place, with a coverage check for any lift.
Inventory shows the finished lifts in the yard, the components they're built from, and how many the shop could build right now.
Dealers have their accounts and orders, from the shop build to shipping and the invoice. The dealer accounts here are samples.
Invoices, quotes, payments and bills are kept right here, or synced to QuickBooks Online instead.
Reports answer questions like how long installs take each crew, and which parts of a lift need the most service.
And the Website section keeps the public site up to date: the installs showcase, used lifts and the dealer list.
Everything here is a working demo with sample data, to show what FiberSteel could run from one system.
